description: Xero manual journals — double-entry adjustments posted directly to the general ledger. Reads are page-paginated and support incremental sync on UpdatedDateUTC via the If-Modified-Since request header. PUT creates a manual journal; POST creates-or-updates one matched on ManualJournalID (operationId updateOrCreateManualJournals). Xero's where and order query params are deliberately NOT declared — a free-form filter/sort expression can never be populated (no default, no pagination/replication ownership, no meaningful stream operator set) and would only ship dead weight into the request. The unitdp query param does NOT apply to this resource: spec commit 648845e wires unitdp onto exactly six operations (BankTransactions, Invoices, Items, Overpayments, Prepayments, Receipts), and ManualJournalLine carries LineAmount/TaxAmount but no Quantity/UnitAmount for it to act on.

pageSize.description: Records per page; owned by pagination. Xero documents a default of 100 and states no maximum, so no pagination `max` is declared.

If-Modified-Since.description: Xero returns only records created or modified at/after this timestamp. Wire format: 2020-02-06T12:17:43.202-08:00. Owned by replication (cursor UpdatedDateUTC).

schema.title: Xero GET ManualJournals response
schema.description: Xero wraps records in the standard response envelope alongside Id/Status/ProviderName/DateTimeUTC metadata and, on paged resources, a sibling lowercase pagination object; the ManualJournals array carries the records. The earlier PageInfo spelling was reverted upstream and is not used.

Status.description: Response envelope: call status (e.g. OK). Not the per-journal Status field.

ProviderName.description: Response envelope: the app that made the call.

DateTimeUTC.description: Response envelope: server timestamp, MS-JSON /Date(...)/ form.

pagination.description: Page-number pagination envelope returned alongside the records.

ManualJournals.description: The manual journal records for this page.

ManualJournalID.description: Xero identifier for the manual journal; the resource primary key and the upsert match key.

Narration.description: Description of the journal being posted — the only property Xero's ManualJournal schema marks Required.

Date.description: Date the journal was posted, MS-JSON date-only envelope (sample /Date(1552521600000+0000)/ = 2019-03-14). Calendar date — no time component, and this resource carries no DateString sibling.

Status.description: Manual journal status. ARCHIVED was appended to the spec enum by commit 503cb5c.

Url.description: Link to a source document — surfaced as 'Go to [appName]' in the Xero app.

ShowOnCashBasisReports.description: Whether the journal appears on cash basis reports. Xero defaults it to true when not specified.

HasAttachments.description: Whether the manual journal has an attachment. The Attachments array itself is not returned by this collection read — it is served by the item-level /ManualJournals/{ManualJournalID}/Attachments path family — so this flag is the collection-level signal.

UpdatedDateUTC.description: Last-modified timestamp, MS-JSON /Date(1552595972920+0000)/ — UTC-anchored. The replication cursor.

StatusAttributeString.description: Validation status attribute returned on write responses (ERROR / WARNING).

JournalLines.description: Manual journal lines (LineAmount, AccountCode, AccountID, Description, TaxType, TaxAmount, Tracking, IsBlank); surfaced opaque. Every monetary amount on this resource lives inside here and carries no per-field native type, so number:money applies nowhere on ManualJournal.

schema.title: Xero manual journal (create)
schema.description: One ManualJournal object, wrapped by the request body in Xero's ManualJournals array envelope (a single-element array per request, so the Idempotency-Key header stays authorable — batching and idempotency are mutually exclusive). Only Narration is declared required: it is the sole property Xero's ManualJournal schema marks Required. Server-maintained and read-only members of the read schema (ManualJournalID, UpdatedDateUTC, HasAttachments, StatusAttributeString) are omitted, and summarizeErrors is not declared because it can never be populated.

Narration.description: Description of the journal being posted.

JournalLines.description: Manual journal lines (LineAmount, AccountCode/AccountID, Description, TaxType, Tracking); passed through opaque.

Date.description: Date the journal is posted (calendar date).

ShowOnCashBasisReports.description: Whether the journal appears on cash basis reports; Xero defaults it to true when not specified.

schema.title: Xero manual journal (create or update)
schema.description: One ManualJournal object carrying the ManualJournalID Xero matches on, wrapped by the request body in the ManualJournals array envelope. POST /ManualJournals is operationId updateOrCreateManualJournals ('Updates or creates a single manual journal'); the item-scoped POST /ManualJournals/{ManualJournalID} is deliberately not used because a per-record id cannot reach path_params. Idempotency is omitted here: the collection POST is matched on the conflict key, so a retry is already convergent. Beyond ManualJournalID and the documented-required Narration, requiredness is not declared.

ManualJournalID.description: Xero identifier of the manual journal to match; the upsert conflict key. Xero creates a new manual journal when it does not resolve to an existing one.

Narration.description: Description of the journal being posted.

JournalLines.description: Manual journal lines (LineAmount, AccountCode/AccountID, Description, TaxType, Tracking); passed through opaque.

Date.description: Date the journal is posted (calendar date).

Status.description: Manual journal status; set VOIDED or DELETED to void/delete an existing journal.

ShowOnCashBasisReports.description: Whether the journal appears on cash basis reports.
